examples.source_context: Detailed geological cross-section of salt domes with Zechstein salt piercing through Triassic-Cretaceous strata. Color-coded lithology with hatching patterns. Professional illustration style.

examples.source_context: Simple conceptual diagram of salt dome with oil trapped along flanks. Clean minimal style. Blue salt body, yellow reservoir, gray overburden.
examples.caption: Salt Dome Concept Diagram (simple clean style)

examples.source_context: F3 Netherlands North Sea interpreted seismic section NW-SE. Multiple Zechstein salt diapirs with color-coded stratigraphy overlay. TWT axis.
examples.caption: F3 Interpreted Seismic Section with Stratigraphy

examples.source_context: Simple cartoon of salt dome piercing through two rock units. Salt body rises from source layer at depth, oil trapped along flanks. Clean, minimal, conceptual style from Geology.com.
examples.caption: Salt Dome Cartoon - piercement through rock units (Geology.com)

examples.source_context: Regional cross-section of East Texas Basin showing multiple salt domes (Hawksville, Mt. Sylvan, Brooks, Boggy Creek) piercing through Jurassic-Pliocene stratigraphy. Color-coded geological units. From Oklahoma/Texas border to coastline. Depth scale in km.
examples.caption: East Texas Basin Salt Domes Regional Cross-Section (Geology.com)

examples.source_context: Seismic survey profile showing central salt core about 1.5 miles wide. Rock layers deformed by upward motion of salt. Depth markers at 3000 and 6000 feet. Classic black-and-white seismic reflection profile.
examples.caption: Salt Dome Seismic Profile (Geology.com)
